verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's rules documentation says rules can be scoped, ramped and scheduled. Rules can also carry a release plan that ramps up automatically over time, and "Ramp schedules" appear as a paid-tier feature on the pricing page. However, the evidence never details a one-off change set to fire at a specific future date and time, and it is unclear which tier gates it. missing for 10: explicit docs for setting a specific future start/end time on a flag change or release, scheduling of published revisions, clarity on plan gating, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can schedule flag changes and releases to happen at a specific future time
